verdict.rationale: The docs say `include_blocks` returns, per page, a blocks array with structural block labels, paragraph-level bounding boxes and content in reading order. Header and footer fields are separated out, and Mistral claims handling of advanced layouts and structured, RAG-ready output. An early tester also praised its PDF-to-markdown conversion, though another reported a page returned as a single image rather than structured text. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading levels or nested section hierarchy (the block-label taxonomy is unspecified), and independent hands-on verification that reading order and structure hold on complex documents.
